description: Behavioral checklist derived from the Life OS feature set. Each check maps to a Playwright test.

checks.label: Page loads in dark mode by default (html.dark class present)
Theme toggle button exists in navbar
Clicking toggle switches html.dark on/off
Theme choice persists in localStorage across reload
No flash of wrong theme on page load
Navbar has 5 links: Dashboard, Goals, Masters, Digest, Review
Active link shows an accent indicator
Route changes are SPA (no full page reload)
Navbar has blur backdrop style
Time-appropriate greeting shown (Good morning / afternoon / evening)
Today's date shown in human-readable format
Overall streak number visible (numeric, even if 0)
Flame icon present next to streak number
Next milestone line shows when streak > 0
Card renders with 'Gym' title and barbell icon
Streak display (flame + number) visible on card
4 workout buttons: Push, Pull, Legs, Cardio
Rest day button visible and labeled
History button visible
Status text reflects initial state ('Select workout')
Accent bar is indigo by default (not done state)
Clicking a workout type selects it (shows as active)
Clicking same workout type again opens the WorkoutDrawer
Clicking Rest day toggles isRest state
Rest day button shows usage count when 1 rest day used
Rest day button is disabled at 2 uses (shows 'Rest limit reached')
Card renders with 'Japanese' title
3 subtask rows: Anki, Duolingo, Study session
Each subtask has an individual streak counter
Progress footer shows 'X of 3 done'
Clicking a subtask marks it checked with strike-through
Clicking again unchecks it
Card accent bar turns green when 2+ subtasks checked
Card is done state (green accent + muted style) when 2+ checked
Card renders with 'DSA' title
3 counters: Easy (green), Med (amber), Hard (red)
+ and − buttons present for each counter
All counters start at 0 or last saved value
Status shows 'Not started' when total is 0
Tapping + increments count by 1
Tapping − decrements count; cannot go below 0
Status shows 'XE · YM · ZH solved' when total > 0
Card accent bar turns green when total > 0
Streak 0 shows muted/gray flame
Streak 1–6 shows amber (warm) flame
Streak 7–29 shows orange (hot) flame
Streak 30+ shows purple (legendary) flame
Flash animation plays briefly on habit completion
Banner hidden when not all habits complete
Banner visible when all 3 habits done (or gym = rest)
Banner text: 'All habits done — you're locked in'
Banner has slide-down entrance animation
Drawer opens when a selected workout type is clicked again
Drawer shows correct workout type title
'Add exercise' button present in drawer
'Done' button present in drawer
Drawer closes on Done click
View-only mode shows transfer banner when switching types with prior logs
Exercise card shows name and weight type label
Expanding card shows set input form
PR badge appears when current max exceeds prior max
Days-since indicator shows urgency colors
Consistency badge shows if 7+ sessions in 30 days
Weight auto-rounds to nearest 2.5 on blur
Weight cannot be below 2.5
Reps counter cannot go below 1
Cable mini-plates capped at 2 per set (note shown)
Time input capped at 59:59 (note shown)
Log button active only when all sets valid
Progress graph opens when chart icon clicked
SVG graph renders with axes and data points
Gold dot present on latest PR session
Tooltip appears on hover with date + value
Max / per-set series toggle works
Y-axis starts from 0
Graph closes on X click
Full page dark mode renders without layout breaks
Full page light mode renders without layout breaks
3-column card grid renders correctly
TopBar renders without overflow
Navbar is visible and not obscured
No requests to unexpected domains (only Supabase + fonts.googleapis.com + fonts.gstatic.com)
No response with Content-Disposition: attachment (mystery download bug)
No 5xx responses from Supabase
No uncaught JS console errors on page load
No unexpected fetch/XHR requests after page idle (no runaway polling)
Supabase requests use anon key header (not exposing service role key)
